Verify Bank Account Details Before Paying a New Chinese Supplier
To verify bank account details before paying a new Chinese supplier, follow these steps:
Confirm the supplier's business license: Ensure the beneficiary matches the company’s legal name on its business license. 
1
Request bank details on letterhead: Obtain bank details on letterhead with a stamp to verify the authenticity of the bank account. 
1
Validate the SWIFT/BIC: Check the SWIFT/BIC and bank address to ensure they are correct and consistent with the supplier’s location. 
1
Confirm any changes: Use a second channel (call/video) to confirm any changes in the bank details. 
1
Use staged payments with inspection: Before finalizing the payment, use staged payments with inspection to verify the quality of the product. 
1

By following these steps, you can reduce the risk of paying to the wrong bank account and protect your investment in international trade.
